patches.title: Color Song
patches.summary: Colors the Song screen's blocks by what's in them: the same instruments share a color family, and variants get their own shades. Colors are saved per project.

patches.title: Humanize
patches.summary: A Pattern screen button that adds small random timing and volume changes to the selected notes. Ranges are set per project in Config.

patches.title: FX Interpolation
patches.summary: MIDI CC FX and synth Macros ramp smoothly to the next step instead of jumping. Switched on per project in Config.

patches.title: Master FX
patches.summary: Choose the master reverb (Freeverb, Plate, Spring, Shimmer) and delay (Tape, BBD, Gated) per project, played with the usual Master Reverb and Delay knobs.

patches.title: Global Swing
patches.summary: A Swing amount per project that every take and every pattern start uses. Off by default; set in Config.

patches.title: Pad Visualizer
patches.summary: Hold Note, Instrument, FX1 and FX2 while a pattern plays and the pads show drifting smoke with ripples from the notes.

patches.title: Conditional Trigs
patches.summary: Turn a Chance FX past 100 and it becomes a condition on how many times the pattern has played: 1st, !1s (not the first), or 1:2 to 8:8 (the A-th pass of every B), counted per track. Idea from Psygoo's CT6.
